subject: general
question: A/An _______ is an organisation that connects its subscriber's computer using modem to the Internet.
solution:
The correct answer is** Internet Service Provider**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Internet Service Provider (ISP):

 
• An ISP is an organization that provides services for accessing, using, or participating in the Internet.
 
• ISPs supply Internet access, employing a range of technologies to connect users to their network.
 
• They use modem and broadband links to provide the connection needed for accessing the internet.

Uniform Resource Locator (URL):

 
• A URL is a reference or address used to access resources on the internet.
 
• This might include websites, files, or other data.
 
• It specifies the location of a resource as well as the protocol used to access it, such as HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP.

Web Browser:

 
• A web browser is a software application used to access and view websites.
 
• Common web browsers include Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Safari.
 
• Browsers interpret and display HTML documents and allow users to navigate between them using hyperlinks.

Web Server:

 
• A web server is a computer system that hosts websites.
 
• It delivers content to users' computers over the internet when requested through a web browser.
 
• This content typically includes web pages, images, and other types of files.
